rows.zh: 发动里齐亚式双重攻击。

rows.en: “Wehlen commands two armies totaling roughly 300,000 soldiers, though only their professional core is considered highly capable. Agnolia fields three armies amounting to 250,000 troops. They are well equipped, but have not seen combat in over three decades.”
rows.zh: “韦伦拥有两支军队，总兵力约 30 万人，但真正被视为精锐的只有其职业化核心部队。阿格诺利亚部署了三支军队，共计 25 万人。他们装备精良，但已有三十多年没有经历过实战。”

rows.en: “Valgsland follows closely. Although they prioritize economic development and social welfare in their budget, CSP funding has allowed them to remain competitive, keeping the gap with Lespia narrow.”
rows.zh: “瓦尔戈斯兰紧随其后。尽管他们在预算中优先考虑经济发展和社会福利，但 康塔纳安全公约 的资金支持使其仍能保持竞争力，与莱斯皮亚之间的差距不大。”

rows.en: “Rumburg maintains 94 naval vessels. Intelligence suggests nearly a third of those are submarines. They also rely on other GRACE nations to help secure maritime routes and protect their trade networks abroad.”
rows.zh: “伦堡拥有 94 艘海军舰艇。情报显示，其中近三分之一是潜艇。他们还依靠其他 皇家商业交流联盟 成员国来帮助保障海上航线，并保护其海外贸易网络。”

rows.en: "Your budget cuts may have put the brakes on our plans for education reform but there is one important change that can still be made."
rows.zh: “您的预算削减也许让我们的教育改革计划被迫刹车，但仍有一项重要的改变可以实现。”

rows.en: "It would cause ripples if we got rid of everyone at once. We will start with Lileas."
rows.zh: “如果一次性把所有人都清除掉，会引起轩然大波。我们先从莉亚斯开始。”

rows.en: "Do we have military options to use against Wehlen?"
rows.zh: “我们有可以对付韦伦的军事选项吗？”

rows.en: "Outside of Zille, very few that are realistic, Your Majesty."
rows.zh: “除了齐勒之外，几乎没有现实可行的选项，陛下。”

rows.en: "President Smolak has spent years fortifying his coastline. The sea approaches are heavily mined, and reinforced with layered naval batteries. United Contana's aid allowed Wehlen to significantly expand those defenses. A naval invasion across the gulf would be operationally unimaginable."
rows.zh: “斯莫拉克总统多年来一直在加固他的海岸线。海上通道布满了水雷，并有层层叠叠的海岸炮台加以强化。康塔纳联盟的援助使韦伦得以大幅扩建这些防御工事。跨越海湾的海上入侵在作战层面上是不可想象的。”

rows.en: "For all his rhetoric, Smolak seeks security and legitimacy. An outright attack would push him firmly into United Contana’s embrace, perhaps beyond retrieval."
rows.zh: “尽管言辞激烈，斯莫拉克追求的是安全与合法性。公然进攻只会把他牢牢推入康塔纳联盟的怀抱，甚至可能再也无法挽回。”

rows.en: "If we move against Wehlen openly, we risk strengthening the very man we could wish to keep in check."
rows.zh: “如果我们公开对韦伦采取行动，就有可能增强我们本想牵制的那个人。”

rows.en: "Additionally, our navy lacks the necessary amphibious capacity for a sustained landing. We also do not possess enough advanced vessels capable of reliably detecting and clearing minefields in the Gulf."
rows.zh: “此外，我们的海军缺乏持续登陆所需的两栖作战能力，也没有足够先进的舰艇来可靠地探测并清除海湾内的雷区。”

rows.en: "Zille is a different matter. It lies on our mainland. There, we can exert intelligence and limited military pressure with far greater feasibility."
rows.zh: “齐勒则是另一回事。它位于我们的本土，在那里，我们施加情报和有限军事压力的可行性要大得多。”

rows.en: "Then Zille is our only pressure point?"
rows.zh: “那么，齐勒是我们唯一的施压点吗？”

rows.en: "Could we overwhelm their defenses with a rapid strike?"
rows.zh: “我们能否通过一次快速打击压倒他们的防御？”

rows.en: "What about air superiority? Could we neutralize their batteries from above?"
rows.zh: “那制空权呢？我们能从空中压制他们的炮台吗？”

rows.en: "The minefields and overlapping coastal guns would break any rapid assault before it reaches land."
rows.zh: “雷区和相互交叠的海岸炮火，会在任何快速突击抵达陆地之前就将其粉碎。”

rows.en: "Contanan radar and anti-air systems would blunt our strikes long before their batteries are neutralized."
rows.zh: “康塔纳的雷达和防空系统，会在他们的炮台被压制之前很久就削弱我们的打击。”

rows.en: "It is the only front where we can apply controlled military and intelligence pressure from our mainland."
rows.zh: “这是我们唯一能从本土施加可控的军事与情报压力的战线。”

rows.en: "I have no desire for war. Wehlen stood by us in a dire time. I will not forget that."
rows.zh: “我不想要战争。韦伦在我们最艰难的时候站在我们这边，我不会忘记这一点。”

rows.en: "We can maintain readiness without provoking the hand that once aided us."
rows.zh: “我们可以保持战备，而不必去激怒那只曾经帮助过我们的手。”

rows.en: "I will get on my knees and personally--"
"Very well, Your Majesty. There may yet be time to solve this diplomatically."
rows.zh: “遵命，陛下。或许还有时间通过外交途径解决此事。”

script.en: Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard was enlarged into a division-sized unit and given expanded duties.
script.zh: 罗穆斯·托拉斯国王在位期间，黄金卫队被扩编为一支师级规模的部队，并被赋予了更广泛的职责。

script.en: Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard was enlarged into a division-sized unit and given expanded duties. Later, the special religious division Wruhec's Guardians was added.
script.zh: 罗穆斯·托拉斯国王在位期间，黄金卫队被扩编为一支师级规模的部队，并被赋予了更广泛的职责。后来，又加入了一支特殊的宗教师团——乌鲁赫守护者。

script.en: Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard expanded to include a new religious division, Wruhec's Guardians.
script.zh: 罗穆斯·托拉斯国王在位期间，黄金卫队进一步扩编，新增了一支宗教师团——乌鲁赫守护者。
